// room: B third floor (interior designer): a library and study under three tall windows. A desk on the centre line
// with a chair and a standing lantern, bookcases round the walls (planks with a slab shelf), a lounge pair in the
// south-east corner. Lanterns hang from the ceiling. The stair well (x12..13, z20..23) and the chimney cells stay clear.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

// K planks (bookcase), T bottom slab (shelf, table top, window seat), F fence (table leg), C/A/E stairs as chairs
// (C back south, A back west, E back east), L hanging lantern, S standing lantern. '#' and '.' are left alone.
const LEGEND = {
  K: "spruce_planks",
  T: ["spruce_slab", { type: "bottom" }],
  F: "spruce_fence",
  C: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom" }],
  A: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "west", half: "bottom" }],
  E: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom" }],
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
  S: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],
};

// Origin [12, 18, 13]: x12..18 across, z13..23 down. One list per storey (y18..21).
const Y18 = [
  "KTKTKTK",
  "K.....K",
  "K.FF..K",
  "K..C..K",
  "K.....K",
  "#.....#",
  "#.....#",
  "##.....",
  "##.....",
  "##..AFE",
  "##.....",
];
const Y19 = [
  "K.K.K.K",
  "K.....K",
  "K.TT..K",
  "K.....K",
  "K.....K",
  "#.....#",
  "#.....#",
  "##.....",
  "##.....",
  "##...T.",
  "##.....",
];
const Y20 = [
  "T.T.T.T",
  "T.....T",
  "T..S..T",
  "T.....T",
  "T.....T",
  "#.....#",
  "#.....#",
  "##.....",
  "##.....",
  "##.....",
  "##.....",
];
const Y21 = [
  ".......",
  ".L...L.",
  ".......",
  ".......",
  ".......",
  "#.....#",
  "#..L..#",
  "##.....",
  "##.....",
  "##...L.",
  "##.....",
];

export function build(g) {
  layers(g, [12, 18, 13], LEGEND, [Y18, Y19, Y20, Y21]);
}

input.summary:
B third floor is furnished as a library and study: a desk with chair and standing lantern on the centre line, spruce-plank bookcases with slab shelves round the walls, a lounge pair (fence table, two stair chairs) in the south-east, and four hanging lanterns. make.sh runs whole: 53 blocks placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines.
Light at the feet is min 8, mean 11, with 0 dark cells. The stair well (x12..13, z20..23) and the head cells above it are left clear.
Walkability is checked only partly: from an inside cell, 50 of 64 floor cells are reached, and the rest are tops of furniture at y20–21. The real verdict says "no way in" because the stair part is still a stub in this copy.
left: Real walk verdict is still UNREACHABLE (no way in): the stair joiner's flight through the B well (x12..13, z20..23, y13..16, carved through the y=17 floor) is a stub in this copy. Rerun `$MCD room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "B third floor"` after the stairs part lands; the well head at (13,18,20) and the lane x13 from z19 to z17 are left clear for it.
Hanging lanterns at y=21 assume a ceiling block at y=22 over the room; the render shows them hanging, but the shell's y=22 cells are not verified here.
Bookcases are spruce planks with a slab shelf, because the palette has no bookshelf or barrel; they read as wood walls more than as books.
The chimney masonry at x=12 and x=18 (z18..19, y5 up) and the flue cells at x=11 and x=19 are not drawn into; the room's free floor there depends on the chimneys part.
plan.md has no checklist and elements.md has no item this interior part builds alone, so nothing was ticked.

waste.what: The furniture grid was drawn by hand from the plan floor grid (7x11 cells, four storeys of rows) and re-checked by eye after each edit.
waste.cost: About 4 layer rows of 11 strings, with the cell coordinates worked out by hand (chairs facing, lounge chair facings, lantern spots).
waste.tool: A `$MCD room --propose-furniture` or a helper that turns a named layout (desk, bookcase wall, lounge) into layers() rows and the chair facings would have saved the hand coordinate work.

waste.what: The walk test needed a hand-written rooms JSON with a different entrance (inside the room) because the real entrance is the stair head, which is still a stub.
waste.cost: One temporary file in /tmp, two walk runs, and parsing the unreached list by hand with node.
waste.tool: `mcd walk --entrance x,y,z` (override the entrance from the command line) and `mcd room --from-inside` would have skipped the temp rooms file and the JSON parse.

waste.what: The light check and the walk verdict were read from separate commands and the floor grid was read by eye for lanes.
waste.cost: Three checks and one render read, no retries after the first make.sh.
waste.tool: `mcd room` could print the lane (free path) from the stair head to each furniture piece, not only the reachable-cell count.

companions.task: Build the B well flight (x12..13, z20..23, up through y=17) and confirm the head cell at (13,18,20) connects to the room, so the walk verdict can be checked for the whole room.
Confirm the four hanging lanterns at y=21 have a ceiling block at y=22 above them, and that the standing lantern on the desk top at (15,20,15) is supported.
Make the bookcases read as books rather than planks, if the palette allowed a bookshelf or barrel.
